'''Rob Morrison''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. From {{aniseries|SM}} to {{aniseries|JN}}, he was credited as '''Roger Callagy'''. He is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Morrison is an actor, musician, and songwriter based in {{wp|New York}}. Morrison joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, where he played various extras. In {{aniseries|SM}}, he gained his two most notable roles: {{an|Rotom Pokédex}} and [[Ash's Rowlet]].
